CustomField.description: Heading shown at the top of the modal opened by a Start New Form or View/Edit Form Submission lookup override (#391). When blank the modal falls back to the field label. Applies only when referenceFormDisplayType__c is modal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional title for the modal that holds the form. If left blank the field label is used instead. Has no effect when the display type is Inline.
CustomField.label: referenceFormModalHeader
